'''Mucous salamanders''', also known as '''pinkish salamanders''', were amphibious reptiles native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Wildlife" />

==Biology and appearance==
Mucous salamanders possessed a unique molecular structure that "loosened" underwater. When submerged, body cells would become porous and amorphous, held together randomly by a subtle electric current. In this state (lasting for as long as it is underwater) it could safely pass through [[Angler/Legends|anglers]]' clutches. It regained solidity back on land.<ref name="Wildlife" />

==History==
Within his first month at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] captured a number of the creatures.
